how: sec.gov refuses an anonymous script; the page was read on 2026-10-04 by the verification pass (reference/verification_v2.json, disney_proxy_5pct). The full sentence is: 'To our knowledge, except as noted below, no person or entity is the beneficial owner of more than 5% of the voting power of the Company’s stock.' The table that follows lists Vanguard (8.5%) and BlackRock (6.9%). The cited passage drops the qualifier.
